item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 05/Oct/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of the northeast monsoon, winds will strengthen gradually over the coast of Guangdong today. There will be a few showers and temperatures will fall slightly in the following couple of days. A dry replenishment of the northeast monsoon is expected to affect southern China early to midweek next week. It will become fine over the region. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large over inland areas.
